mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases to counter economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales (both falling below their 3-month moving averages) signal a severe demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS fall below their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output contraction pressures corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts over the past 3 months indicates weakening residential demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1800 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1800.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in nonfarm payrolls and increases in unemployment rate signal a rapidly deteriorating labor market, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS falls below its 3-month moving average and UNRATE rises above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals aggressive monetary easing to counter economic weakness, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
